about.heading: Five people who put on comedy shows.
about.body:
Stoned Goose Productions is a five-person comedy production company based in Olympia, Washington. We started in January 2025.

We produce live stand-up across Olympia, Lacey, Tacoma, and the wider South Sound. That means booking the lineup, running the room, and handling the parts of a show an audience is never supposed to notice. We also work on camera and behind a microphone, producing video and podcasts for comics and for the people who hire us.

The Open Mic Explorer is ours too: a map and an app that tracks open mics across the Pacific Northwest, and the video series that goes with it.

contact.heading: Tell us what you are planning.
contact.body: A room, an event, a set you want on tape, a podcast you want made. Send us the details and we will come back within two business days.
